title: Choose COVENANT's new visual world
question: Pick the world that should carry COVENANT across the judge, proof, facility, attacks, and operator surfaces.

options.label: Settlement Switchboard
options.lineage: high-value payment clearing rooms and physical routing panels
options.thesis: One visible route carries an external payment through proof verification into drawable capital.
options.viewport: A wide clearing rail connects 5 USDC on Sepolia to the Attestcoin proof aperture and 4 CTC drawn, with six public evidence links integrated into the route.
options.risk: Physical instrument language becomes cold when texture outranks the financial story.

raised.raise: Every dense region restates its own heading and current position.
The proof sequence has one unmistakable current step and a visible rest state.
Information density adapts by viewport without shrinking the type into noise.
Every completed stage leaves a cumulative, inspectable record.

options.label: Security Print Instrument
options.lineage: central-bank specimen notes, bond certificates, and anti-counterfeit engraving
options.thesis: The credit facility becomes a living financial instrument whose proof marks are impossible to mistake for decoration.
options.viewport: A monumental split instrument shows the Sepolia obligation on the left, the Creditcoin facility on the right, and a live proof seal crossing the central security thread.
options.risk: Security-print styling is familiar in trust products and fails when treated as ornamental vintage paper.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1970s pocket airline timetables on a backlit inspection table
options.thesis: The proof chain reads as a precise departure sequence with fixed windows, codes, and visible progress.
options.viewport: Raked evidence slides cross a lit bed from Sepolia departure to Creditcoin settlement, with each slide carrying one checkable artifact.
options.case: Strong sequence clarity and public-link density, with weaker identification as a financial product.
options.risk: The travel reference becomes nostalgic when the rake and single-size type rule are softened.

options.label: Settlement Sequencer
options.lineage: early-80s rhythm-machine step rows and studio instruments
options.thesis: Each covenant stage is armed, verified, or rejected as a tactile step in one capital sequence.
options.viewport: A six-step causal row fills the fold, with payment, proof, satisfaction, draw, and replay state shown as instrument keys beneath the capital readout.
options.case: Exceptional interaction clarity and broad approachability, with a less formal financial association.
options.risk: Music-hardware character risks making a serious credit mechanism feel playful.

options.label: ASCII Proof Field
options.lineage: live scenes rendered as typewriter-character density
options.thesis: Every proof, receipt, and capital state is rendered inside one selectable character field.
options.viewport: A proof packet resolves from sparse glyphs into a dense settlement record.
options.case: High technical identification but lower clarity for the full public audience.
options.risk: Terminal culture would repeat the current interface's main weakness.
options.kept: Responsive information density without shrinking text.

options.label: Hard-Cut Title System
options.thesis: Each protocol state lands as an unforgettable freeze-frame composition.
options.viewport: The capital consequence crashes into the fold as a numbered proof session.
options.case: Memorable, but weakens the institutional trust expected from credit infrastructure.
options.risk: The entertainment reference competes with public evidence.

options.label: Living Signal Skin
options.thesis: The interface changes material state as evidence moves from neutral to verified or rejected.
options.viewport: A proof signal propagates across a living surface from obligation to capital.
options.case: Strong state expression, but the biological carrier obscures financial purpose.
options.risk: The medium would become the subject.
options.kept: One coherent signal language across neutral, valid, and rejected states.

options.label: Cumulative Course Record
options.thesis: Each verified obligation adds one visible course to the facility's capital structure.
options.viewport: A vertical facility section accumulates proof courses until the next tranche becomes drawable.
options.case: Clear cumulative consequence, with poor fit for dense transaction inspection.
options.risk: Material warmth softens the cryptographic precision.
options.kept: Every completed stage leaves a permanent cumulative record.

canonCard.label: Premium Fintech Standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished dark institutional dashboard with restrained charts and card-based evidence.
canonCard.viewport: A centered headline above live facility metrics, proof timeline, and evidence cards.
canonCard.risk: Competent and familiar, but visually interchangeable with many crypto finance products.
